3. Property of Equality: do same operation to both sides

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Margaret's New Pet
revealWordProblem.text:
Margaret is researching dog breeds to adopt. The average weight of a bulldog is 50 pounds, and the list gives the other breeds she is considering.
Pugs weigh 32 pounds less than bulldogs.
Irish Setters weigh 20 pounds more than bulldogs.
Irish Terriers weigh 43 pounds less than Irish Setters.
Shiba Inu weigh 5 pounds more than pugs.
Question: If Margaret's apartment building only allows dogs up to 30 pounds, which breed or breeds would you recommend she adopt?
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A photograph of a bulldog with a card reading: Average Weight of Bulldog, 50 pounds.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Start from the bulldog's 50 pounds and write an equation for each breed. Pug: p = 50 − 32 = 18 pounds. Irish Setter: s = 50 + 20 = 70 pounds. Irish Terrier: t = 70 − 43 = 27 pounds. Shiba Inu: i = 18 + 5 = 23 pounds. Now compare each with the 30-pound limit: pug 18 ✓, Shiba Inu 23 ✓, Irish Terrier 27 ✓, bulldog 50 ✗, Irish Setter 70 ✗. I would recommend the pug, the Shiba Inu, or the Irish Terrier — all three are under the building's 30-pound limit.

questions.explanation: Subtract 9 from both sides: x = 15 − 9 = 6. Check: 6 + 9 = 15 ✓
choiceFeedback: That number is already showing in the equation as the amount being added, not the unknown. Undo the addition by subtracting it from both sides.
That is the total after 9 was added, not the starting value. Work backward from the total by subtracting 9 from both sides.
Not quite. Subtract 9 from both sides: x = 15 − 9 = ___.
hints: x has 9 added to it. To get x alone, you need to UNDO that addition.
Use the inverse operation: subtraction undoes addition. Whatever you do, do it to BOTH sides to keep the balance.
Subtract 9 from both sides: x = 15 − 9. Then check by adding 9 back to your result — do you land on 15?
questions.explanationEs: Resta 9 en ambos lados: x = 15 − 9 = 6. Comprueba: 6 + 9 = 15 ✓
hintsEs: A x se le suman 9. Para dejar x sola, tienes que DESHACER esa suma.
Usa la operación inversa: la resta deshace la suma. Lo que hagas, hazlo en AMBOS lados para mantener el equilibrio.
Resta 9 de ambos lados: x = 15 − 9. Luego comprueba sumando 9 de nuevo a tu resultado: ¿llegas a 15?

questions.explanation: Add 7 to both sides: y = 20 + 7 = 27. Check: 27 − 7 = 20 ✓
choiceFeedback: That is the amount being subtracted, not the value of y. Undo the subtraction by adding it to both sides.
Not quite. Add 7 to both sides: y = 20 + 7 = ___.
The two numbers got multiplied. Subtraction is undone by addition, so add 7 to both sides instead.
hints: Look at what's happening to y: 7 is being SUBTRACTED. Which operation undoes subtraction?
Add the same amount to both sides so the equation stays balanced and y ends up alone.
Add 7 to both sides: y = 20 + 7. Check your result: does it minus 7 give back 20?
questions.explanationEs: Suma 7 en ambos lados: y = 20 + 7 = 27. Comprueba: 27 − 7 = 20 ✓
hintsEs: Mira lo que le pasa a y: se le RESTA 7. ¿Qué operación deshace una resta?
Suma la misma cantidad a ambos lados para que la ecuación siga equilibrada y y quede sola.
Suma 7 a ambos lados: y = 20 + 7. Comprueba tu resultado: ¿restarle 7 devuelve 20?

questions.explanation: Subtract 15 from both sides: n = 42 − 15 = 27. Check: 27 + 15 = 42 ✓
choiceFeedback: That is the amount being added, not the starting value. Subtract 15 from both sides to peel it away from n.
That is the total after 15 was added. Work backward from the total by subtracting 15 from both sides.
Not quite. Subtract 15 from both sides: n = 42 − 15 = ___.
hints: n is being increased by 15. To find n alone, you must undo that addition.
Subtract 15 from both sides — the +15 and −15 cancel on the left, leaving just n.
Compute 42 − 15 carefully (42 − 10 = 32, then take away 5 more). Check by adding 15 back to your answer.
questions.explanationEs: Resta 15 en ambos lados: n = 42 − 15 = 27. Comprueba: 27 + 15 = 42 ✓
hintsEs: A n se le aumentan 15. Para hallar n sola, debes deshacer esa suma.
Resta 15 de ambos lados: el +15 y el −15 se cancelan a la izquierda y queda solo n.
Calcula 42 − 15 con cuidado (42 − 10 = 32 y luego quita 5 más). Comprueba sumando 15 a tu respuesta.

reviewHighlights.formula: x + a = b → x = b − a | x − a = b → x = b + a
steps: 2. Use inverse operation: subtract to undo addition; add to undo subtraction
3. Property of Equality: do same operation to both sides
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake is applying the same operation instead of the inverse — for example, solving x − 7 = 15 by subtracting 7 from both sides (getting the wrong x = 8) instead of adding 7 to both sides (the correct x = 22). Another common mistake is doing the inverse operation to only one side, like solving x + 6 = 14 by subtracting 6 from the left but forgetting the right side. Before you submit, name the operation shown in the equation, choose its inverse, apply it to BOTH sides, and check by substituting your answer back into the original equation.

level2.stem: Kai solved x − 12 = 30 and got x = 18. Is he right? What is x?
level2.stemEs: Kai resolvió x − 12 = 30 y obtuvo x = 18. ¿Tiene razón? ¿Cuánto vale x?
hints: Check Kai's answer first: what is 18 − 12? Then think about which operation undoes − 12.
hintsEs: Primero comprueba la respuesta de Kai: ¿cuánto es 18 − 12? Luego piensa qué operación deshace − 12.
level2.explanation: Check Kai's answer: 18 − 12 = 6 ✗ Add 12 to both sides: x = 30 + 12 = 42 Check by putting 42 in for x: 42 − 12 = 30 ✓
level2.explanationEs: Comprueba la respuesta de Kai: 18 − 12 = 6 ✗ Suma 12 en los dos lados: x = 30 + 12 = 42 Comprueba poniendo 42 en lugar de x: 42 − 12 = 30 ✓

level2.stem: Some players were at the park. Then 13 players went home. Now 25 players are at the park. How many players were there at first?
level2.stemEs: Había algunos jugadores en el parque. Luego 13 jugadores se fueron a casa. Ahora hay 25 jugadores en el parque. ¿Cuántos jugadores había al principio?
hints: Let p be the players at first. 13 went home, so write p − 13 = 25.
hintsEs: Sea p la cantidad de jugadores al principio. Se fueron 13, así que escribe p − 13 = 25.
level2.explanation: Write the equation: p − 13 = 25 Add 13 to both sides: p = 25 + 13 = 38 Check by putting 38 in for p: 38 − 13 = 25 ✓
level2.explanationEs: Escribe la ecuación: p − 13 = 25 Suma 13 en los dos lados: p = 25 + 13 = 38 Comprueba poniendo 38 en lugar de p: 38 − 13 = 25 ✓

level3.stem: Which value of n is the solution of n − 18 = 27?
choiceFeedback: That subtracts 18 from 27. The variable already had 18 taken away, so ADD it back.
That is the amount subtracted, not the solution. Add it to 27.
That is the value after 18 was subtracted, not n itself. Add 18 to recover n.
level3.explanation: The variable has 18 subtracted from it, so add 18 to both sides to isolate n: n = 27 + 18 = 45. Check by substituting: 45 − 18 = 27.

level3.stem: Ana and Ben solve x + 9.5 = 20. Ana gets 10.5. Ben gets 29.5. What is x?
level3.stemEs: Ana y Ben resuelven x + 9.5 = 20. Ana obtiene 10.5. Ben obtiene 29.5. ¿Cuánto vale x?
hints: Put each answer in for x. Which one makes the left side 20?
hintsEs: Pon cada respuesta en lugar de x. ¿Cuál hace que el lado izquierdo sea 20?
level3.explanation: Subtract 9.5 from both sides: x = 20 − 9.5 = 10.5 Test both answers: 10.5 + 9.5 = 20 ✓; 29.5 + 9.5 = 39 ✗
level3.explanationEs: Resta 9.5 en los dos lados: x = 20 − 9.5 = 10.5 Prueba las dos respuestas: 10.5 + 9.5 = 20 ✓; 29.5 + 9.5 = 39 ✗

hints: 6.25 is subtracted from n. Add 6.25 to both sides.
hintsEs: A n se le resta 6.25. Suma 6.25 en los dos lados.
level3.explanation: Add 6.25 to both sides: n = 13.5 + 6.25 = 19.75 Check by putting 19.75 in for n: 19.75 − 6.25 = 13.5 ✓
level3.explanationEs: Suma 6.25 en los dos lados: n = 13.5 + 6.25 = 19.75 Comprueba poniendo 19.75 en lugar de n: 19.75 − 6.25 = 13.5 ✓

level3.stem: A store lowered the price of a jacket by $14.50. The new price is $39.99. Write and solve an equation. What was the old price?
level3.stemEs: Una tienda bajó el precio de una chaqueta en $14.50. El precio nuevo es $39.99. Escribe y resuelve una ecuación. ¿Cuál era el precio anterior?
hints: Let p be the old price. The store took $14.50 off, so write p − 14.50 = 39.99.
hintsEs: Sea p el precio anterior. La tienda le quitó $14.50, así que escribe p − 14.50 = 39.99.
level3.explanation: Write the equation: p − 14.50 = 39.99 Add 14.50 to both sides: p = 39.99 + 14.50 = 54.49 Check by putting 54.49 in for p: 54.49 − 14.50 = 39.99 ✓
level3.explanationEs: Escribe la ecuación: p − 14.50 = 39.99 Suma 14.50 en los dos lados: p = 39.99 + 14.50 = 54.49 Comprueba poniendo 54.49 en lugar de p: 54.49 − 14.50 = 39.99 ✓

level3.stem: A box and a bag weigh 15.5 pounds together. The bag weighs 6.75 pounds. A crate weighs 4.3 pounds less than the box. How much does the crate weigh?
level3.stemEs: Una caja y una bolsa pesan 15.5 libras juntas. La bolsa pesa 6.75 libras. Un cajón pesa 4.3 libras menos que la caja. ¿Cuánto pesa el cajón?
hints: Solve for the box first with b + 6.75 = 15.5. Then write an equation for the crate.
hintsEs: Primero halla la caja con b + 6.75 = 15.5. Luego escribe una ecuación para el cajón.
level3.explanation: Solve for the box: b + 6.75 = 15.5; b = 15.5 − 6.75 = 8.75 Write an equation for the crate: c = 8.75 − 4.3 Subtract to find c: 8.75 − 4.3 = 4.45
level3.explanationEs: Halla el peso de la caja: b + 6.75 = 15.5; b = 15.5 − 6.75 = 8.75 Escribe una ecuación para el cajón: c = 8.75 − 4.3 Resta para hallar c: 8.75 − 4.3 = 4.45

steps.title: Find the Terrier and Shiba Inu

items: Irish Terrier: 43 lb less than Setter
Shiba Inu: 5 lb more than pug

workedSteps.answer: Recommend the pug (18 lb), the Shiba Inu (23 lb), or the Irish Terrier (27 lb) — all under the 30-pound limit.
